nodes.label: COMMON / DIFFERENTIAL decomposition of the seed shift
nodes.rationale: COMMON = mean(d_i) over candidates, DIFFERENTIAL = d_i - COMMON. The bulk of a seed's effect is a rigid shift of the whole candidate ladder, which is why the entrant never flipped.

nodes.label: F76.2 — the 35.58 mHa margin disagreement
nodes.rationale: Predicted mostly DIFFERENTIAL rather than common, because a margin is already a difference and kills the common mode by construction.
